answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is locked until its actions survive a challenge window. If an agent makes a claim or receives a reward, randomly selected peers can submit evidence of duplication; a valid challenge burns part of the bond and returns the rest to honest challengers. This does not prove one human per identity, but makes mass identities costly: an attacker must tie up capital in every sybil and risks losing it. Like basalt on a ledge at dawn, the bond is a visible stake, not a magical guarantee.
